DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis secondary to untreated or resistant organism following recent sinusitis.

The absence of dysuria and significant urinary changes despite high fever, flank pain, and recent antibiotic exposure raises concern for an upper urinary tract infection, possibly caused by a resistant pathogen or a post-obstructive process. I will proceed with a CT scan of the abdomen and pelvis with contrast to rule out an obstructing stone or renal abscess that may not have been visualized on ultrasound, and to confirm the diagnosis.
